verdict.rationale: Lovable documents a built-in AI connector that 'handles that setup for you,' and its Cloud backend includes AI with 'no infrastructure setup required.' Together these directly support adding AI features to a generated app without the user wiring up a provider. However, the evidence never explicitly says provider API keys are managed by Lovable, and it gives no detail on LLM calls versus agent-style features. missing for 10: explicit statement that provider keys are managed or abstracted, documented support for agents (not just generic AI features), supported models and usage limits, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can add AI features like LLM calls and agents to my generated app without managing provider keys myself

citations.quote: Lovable's built-in AI connector handles that setup for you, so you can add AI features to your app by describing what you want to build.
includes a built-in backend (Cloud) with database, authentication, storage, edge functions, and AI, no infrastructure setup required.
